verified: edh-next-123 review (must-finish round, EDHREC rank 4990), by hand against the Oracle text, the Scryfall rulings (2024-11-08, name only) and the CR 2026-09-25 text. Static: layer 4 removes Creature while you control fewer than three permanents you don't own (sta.edhn123.notCreature.unless; CR 604.1, 611.3a, 613.1d). End step trigger: the bottom card of each opponent's library exiled face down (topCards fromBottom, CR 401.2, 406.3), then one lasting effect until none of them is in exile: you may look at them and cast the permanent ones with mana of any color (eff.edhn123.lookAndCastPermanents.remainExiled.anyColor; CR 611.2b, 601.3, 609.4b, 400.7). Played in edh-next-123-scenarios.test.ts (owners can't see or cast them, an instant is not castable, a flash creature is cast with white mana for {G}, a non-flash creature on your next turn). Held-out, opened by the owner (commander request 2026-10-27, more cards 2026-10-30).

edh-next-123 review (must-finish round, EDHREC rank 3409), by hand against the Oracle text, the Scryfall rulings 2023-10-13 and the CR 2026-09-25 text. For each opponent in turn order (each chooses and the option is done before the next chooses, ruling): a villainous may of that opponent (CR 701.55a, 701.55b); first option: they exile until a nonland card and YOU may cast it free (the ruling: they don't choose whether you cast it); second: the top four exiled, damage equal to their total mana value to that player (eff.edhn123.villainous.exileUntilCastOrTopDamage; CR 202.3, 120.3, 608.2c). Played in edh-next-123-scenarios.test.ts. Held-out, opened by the owner (commander request 2026-10-27, more cards 2026-10-30).

edh-next-123 review (must-finish round, EDHREC rank 4901), by hand against the Oracle text, the Scryfall rulings 2013-04-15 and the CR 2026-09-25 text. Cast trigger of any player from their hand: the spell exiled, the caster exiles until a card that shares a card type with it (read as it last existed when it is gone, CR 608.2h; ruling: a second Storm still exiles until a match), the caster may cast it free, then every card this resolution exiled that is still in exile (the spell, the cards not cast) to the bottom of its owner's library in a random order (eff.edhn123.exileSpell.exileUntilSharesType.castFree.exiledBottom; CR 406.1, 400.7, 400.3, 608.2g). Played in edh-next-123-scenarios.test.ts (cast and declined, two Storms, a card cast from exile does not trigger it). Held-out, opened by the owner (commander request 2026-10-27, more cards 2026-10-30).

edh-next-123 review (must-finish round, EDHREC rank 4515), by hand against the Oracle text, the Scryfall ruling 2022-06-10 and the CR 2026-09-25 text. Trigger: a spell you cast you don't own makes a 3/3 black Demon (already full). +1: draw, then one up-to-one target instant or sorcery card in each opponent's graveyard exiled with a page counter on it (counter word 'page', CR 122.1; per-opponent target CR 601.2c, 115.1). -3: you may cast a nonland card in exile with a page counter on it, whoever owns it, free during the resolution only (eff.edhn123.cast.fromExile.anyWithCounters.free; CR 601.2, 118.9, 608.2g; ruling 2022-06-10). Played in edh-next-123-scenarios.test.ts (Demon from the free cast of an opponent's card). Held-out, opened by the owner (commander request 2026-10-27, more cards 2026-10-30).

edh-next-123 review (must-finish round, EDHREC rank 4517), by hand against the Oracle text (no Scryfall rulings) and the CR 2026-09-25 text. One target for each player (a nonenchantment, nonland permanent that player controls, CR 601.2c, 115.1); the targets into their owners' libraries and those owners shuffle (CR 400.3, 701.24a); for each player who controlled one of them as it last existed (CR 608.2h) in turn order (CR 101.4): exile until a nonland card, the rest to the bottom in a random order; then each of those players may cast the card they exiled free (eff.edhn123.ownersShuffle.exileUntilNonland.eachCastsFree; CR 601.2, 118.9, 608.2g). Played in edh-next-123-scenarios.test.ts (a stolen permanent goes to its owner's library and its controller exiles from their own; a player with no target exiles nothing). Held-out, opened by the owner (commander request 2026-10-27, more cards 2026-10-30).
